# OwnX Progress

> OwnX builds AI you control. Own1 is a personal AI computer for your home or office. Nexy is its assistant, on your laptop, your phone and in the cloud too. OwnX Console runs AI apps on servers you choose, and Earth Compute maps what that computing power costs around the world.

Updated 2026-11-21. Page: https://progress.ownx.co/

## Products
- Own1 (live): A personal AI computer: the AI runs on the box, and your data stays on hardware you own. Next: Owner approval for every outbound action
- OwnXOS (live): The operating system under every Own1: each app in its own container, the whole system defined in one reproducible configuration. Next: Owner approval for every outbound action, and proof of which software each box runs
- OwnX Desktop (live): The desktop on every Own1: an app store, studios and AI employees, in owner or demo mode. Next: Its own AI service, fully separate from the demo
- Nexy (live): One assistant for chat, research, projects and routines, the same wherever you run it. Next: One request built across all your devices at once, shown live
- Nexy Engine (live): The agent behind Nexy: a new engine in Rust, built to stay out of the AI model's way. Next: Smarter research on slower models
- Nexy for Mac and Windows (prototype): Nexy as a desktop app: on your own computer, in Nexy Cloud, or on your Own1. Next: Asking questions about a folder of documents
- Nexy for Android and iPhone (prototype): Nexy on your phone, powered by your own Own1 or Nexy Cloud. The phone needs no AI model of its own. Next: iPhone app
- Private network (prototype): An encrypted network joining your devices, where each device's address comes from its own key. Next: Your devices sharing AI: a phone using your Own1's GPU
- Nexy Cloud (prototype): Nexy hosted for you, for anyone without an Own1 yet. Next: Accounts with passkey sign-in, then GPU credits
- Earth Compute (live): Live index of what compute, AI and infrastructure really cost, with a global map of data centers and an API. Next: Paid API access using the shared OwnX sign-in.
- OwnX Console (prototype): A console for running AI apps on servers you control, from choosing hardware to a live, one-click deploy. Next: Personal sign-in with passkeys, then owner-only deploy controls.
- OwnX CLI (prototype): A command-line tool for your servers, with live prices from Earth Compute. Next: More commands as OwnX Console grows

## Shipped features, newest first (date merged)
- 2026-11-20, OwnXOS: Every update tested on a brand-new Own1. Each change is built and booted on a fresh box before release, so new owners get exactly what was tested.
- 2026-11-20, OwnXOS: Leaner AI services, rewritten in Rust. Device pairing and the AI gateway now run as small, fast programs, leaving more of the box for the AI models.
- 2026-11-19, Nexy Cloud: Nexy Cloud answers on a trusted Own1. Cloud users get answers from a full-size model on an Own1 that has spare capacity, and every reply says where it ran.
- 2026-11-19, OwnXOS: One gateway for every AI model. A single service starts, shares and watches the box's models, and restarts one that stops responding.
- 2026-11-18, Own1: Choose what each device can do. The owner sets a device's access when approving it, and can change it at any time.
- 2026-11-18, OwnXOS: Chat and images at the same time. The box keeps room for the text and image models together, so neither waits for the other.
- 2026-11-18, Nexy Apps: One Nexy everywhere. Own1 runs the same Nexy as the apps and the web, so every improvement reaches every device at once.
- 2026-11-18, OwnX Desktop: A choice of agent engines. Owners can run Nexy Engine or one of two other open-source agents, each with its own tools.
- 2026-11-18, Own1: Safer device pairing. Adding a device needs a recent owner sign-in and a single-use approval on the box.
- 2026-11-18, Nexy Apps: Use a friend's Own1 for AI. Sync with someone else's Own1 for its AI only, with guest screens that show whose Own1 you're on.
- 2026-11-18, Nexy Apps: Images from your Own1 on any device. Ask for an image from a phone or laptop and Nexy waits for your Own1, showing progress.
- 2026-11-17, OwnX Console: One-click deploy with a live log. Press Deploy once to see each build step as it runs, then get a working link to the live app when it finishes.
- 2026-11-17, OwnX Console: Deploy plan on one screen. Before you deploy, you see the exact model, server and address the app will use, priced against the live compute market.
- 2026-11-17, OwnX Console: Builder workspace. Apps you build for clients sit in their own workspace, clearly separate from the servers and services you run yourself.
- 2026-11-17, OwnX Console: Public page for the sample hotel app. The sample hotel app now has a public home page where anyone can chat with its reservations assistant, with fair-use limits per visitor.
- 2026-11-17, Nexy Apps: Only what your computer runs well. Nexy offers the features your model passed in our tests on a computer like yours, and points the rest to your Own1.
- 2026-11-14, OwnX Console: Organisation and project switcher. Move between organisations and projects in one click, with live project counts and a page for each project.
- 2026-11-14, OwnX Console: Fast first load. The console opens quickly, with compressed, cached assets and a placeholder layout while data arrives.
- 2026-11-14, OwnX Console: Agents, models and routing on real data. See your agents, models, inference routing, domains, a billing estimate and an architecture map built from your real servers, on desktop or phone.
- 2026-11-14, OwnX Console: Cheapest-first setup guide. A step-by-step guide suggests the lowest-cost server and model that fit your app before you commit.
- 2026-11-14, OwnX Console: Sample private AI reservations app. A ready-made example app with a private model, an inbox and an agent connector shows how to build and ship an AI app on your own server.
- 2026-11-14, OwnX Console: Fleet dashboard and Earth Compute prices. One read-only view of your servers' health and usage beside live compute prices across data centre providers, with keys and private details kept out of every answer.
- 2026-11-14, Nexy Apps: Reconnects by itself. If the link to your Own1 drops, Nexy reconnects on its own, and after an update it shows what changed.
- 2026-11-14, OwnX CLI: Cheapest compute and AI from the terminal. Ask for the lowest-cost server or AI model from Earth Compute's live prices, ranked by provider and location.
- 2026-11-14, OwnX CLI: Deploy from the terminal. A deploy command that checks the plan before anything changes.
- 2026-11-14, OwnX CLI: Usage and logs for every app. CPU, memory and storage per app, and every service's logs, the same figures the console shows.
- 2026-11-14, OwnX CLI: Works with both server versions. Runs against current and next-generation servers, and installs with one Nix command.
- 2026-11-13, Earth Compute: Add your data center. Data center operators can submit their facility from the Providers page and get a reference number straight away.
- 2026-11-13, Earth Compute: New API docs and API access requests. Developers get short, accurate API docs and can request access from the same page.
- 2026-11-13, Earth Compute: AI model prices refreshed hourly. AI model prices and their history in the API stay current through the day, not once a day.
- 2026-11-13, Nexy Apps: Nexy for Windows beta. Windows joins Mac and Android, and every app tells you in your chat when an update is ready.
- 2026-11-13, Nexy Apps: Simpler, safer pairing. Type your Own1's name and Nexy finds it; a new device joins only when you tap Allow.
- 2026-11-13, OwnX CLI: Your servers from the terminal. A command-line client shows your servers' apps, usage and logs, signed in with a key only you hold.
- 2026-11-12, OwnX Desktop: Owner mode and demo mode, one system. The same software runs a private owner box or a public demo, so the demo shows the real product.
- 2026-11-12, OwnX Desktop: Devices page. Pair phones and laptops, hand out guest codes, and remove a device in one tap.
- 2026-11-12, Own1: Your devices use your Own1's AI. Paired laptops and phones run on the box's models, with the owner always first in line.
- 2026-11-12, OwnX Desktop: Publish a page from your box. Share puts a saved page online and keeps it there until you unpublish it.
- 2026-11-12, Nexy Apps: Nexy on Telegram. Message your Own1's assistant from Telegram.
- 2026-11-12, Nexy Apps: Gmail and email-triggered routines. Connect Gmail read-only, and let a routine run when an email arrives, once you turn it on.
- 2026-11-11, Nexy Apps: Your phone uses your Mac's Nexy. Scan a code and your phone runs on your Mac's AI; Nexy picks the best model the Mac can run.
- 2026-11-10, Nexy Apps: Nexy 0.2 beta for Mac and Android. Run your own AI on your computer, or sync with your Own1 and use it from any device.
- 2026-11-08, Earth Compute: Daily GPU price check. Every day, GPU prices are checked against the providers' own price lists, so the numbers people compare are ones they can actually buy at.
- 2026-11-08, Nexy Apps: Prompts stay on your computer. On this-computer mode, every prompt stays on the computer unless you choose to use your Own1.
- 2026-11-07, Earth Compute: Price freshness on the Providers page. Each provider shows when it was last checked and when its prices last changed.
- 2026-11-06, Earth Compute: GPU price history by chip. For each GPU model, people can see how its price has moved across providers over time, in today's dollars.
- 2026-11-06, Earth Compute: AI image, video, audio and embedding price indexes. One index line per AI service type shows how its price has changed since launch, with each vendor switchable on or off.
- 2026-11-06, Nexy Apps: Nexy apps that update themselves. Nexy for Mac and Android installs its own updates and reaches your Own1 over the private network.
- 2026-11-05, Earth Compute: Datacenters tab. Every facility on one searchable table, each row opening its own page with a 3D map.
- 2026-11-04, OwnX Desktop: Personal demo codes. Every visitor gets their own one-time code to try the demo desktop.
- 2026-10-28, Nexy Apps: Turn a chat into a project. A conversation with several steps becomes a project you can come back to.
- 2026-10-28, Nexy Apps: Take over the agent's browser. Watch the agent browse live, and take control yourself whenever you want.
- 2026-10-27, OwnX Desktop: Image jobs wait their turn. A queued image waits for the graphics card instead of failing.
- 2026-10-26, OwnX Desktop: AI employees that leave receipts. They work in their role, wait for your review and keep working with the tab closed.
- 2026-10-26, Nexy Apps: Click any part of a page to edit it. Point at a heading or a footer and say what to change.
- 2026-10-26, OwnX Desktop: Every NixOS package, 365 self-hosted apps. Browse, ask Nexy about an app, and open it with one link.
- 2026-10-26, Nexy Apps: Routines that run around the clock. A new routine runs straight away, then on its schedule.
- 2026-10-26, OwnX Desktop: Report a problem, kept on your box. Feedback is saved on the owner's own hardware, not sent away.
- 2026-10-23, OwnX Desktop: Nexy becomes the Own1 assistant. One always-on assistant across the whole desktop.
- 2026-10-23, Nexy Apps: Edit the open page in place. Changes apply to the page you are looking at instead of rebuilding it.
- 2026-10-20, OwnXOS: Four conversations at once. The text model now serves four requests at the same time.
- 2026-10-20, OwnX Desktop: Sites fix their own broken images. A build repairs missing images and clipped labels instead of failing.
- 2026-10-02, Earth Compute: Instrument detail API. Developers can pull the full figures behind any index page, including breakdowns, inventory and regions, in one call.
- 2026-08-12, Earth Compute: AI model catalogue in the API. Developers can query AI model prices and specs alongside compute, storage and network data.

## In review
- OwnX Desktop: One address and one sign-in for the whole box. Every app on an Own1 opens from a single address after a single sign-in.
- OwnXOS: Agents ready on the very first boot. A brand-new box has its assistant working the first time it starts.

## Planned
- Nexy Cloud: Accounts with passkey sign-in. Sign in with your phone's or laptop's passkey; no password to remember.
- Nexy Cloud: GPU credits. Buy credits for faster cloud GPUs when you need them; free use stays free.
- Nexy Apps: iPhone app. Nexy on iPhone, joining Mac, Windows and Android.
- Earth Compute: Paid API access with OwnX sign-in. One OwnX account to sign in, create API keys and pay for higher limits, with the same balance as other OwnX products.
- Earth Compute: Globe view in the OwnX Console. The Earth Compute globe will show directly inside the console's Map tab.
- OwnX Console: Personal sign-in. Each person signs in with their own account, including passkeys, instead of a shared login.
- OwnX Console: Owner-only deploy controls. Only a project's owners can deploy or change it; everyone else gets a view-only console.
- OwnX Console: Smarter setup defaults. The setup guide starts with the model and server that best fit your app, so most deploys need no changes.
